title: Distribution of sulfidized silver nanoparticles across abiotic and biotic environmental compartments: a long-term floodplain mesocosm study
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,4629-4645
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN01170H, Paper
George Metreveli, Sandra Kurtz, Karin Leuthold, Sebastian Kuehr, Christian Schlechtriem, Simon Lüderwald, Mirco Bundschuh, Ralf Schulz, Gabriele E. Schaumann
The enrichment of Ag in/on mussels, biofilms, amphipods, and leaves observed for sulfidized silver nanoparticles suggests a potential threat for the organisms feeding on those resources and an enhanced risk of trophic transfer of these nanoparticles.
